description: Cyclist occlusion conflict (edge case 05) on yale-street: car, truck, wrong-way cyclist and pedestrian replayed from the render timeline through `simforge-render job` (committed document lowered to the service stream with groundY 0: baked heights authoritative). Chase camera: the retired playback binary's follow camera on the first actor (delivery-truck). Ticks 0..119 render; tick 60 is hashed. Gates: pass hashes, a non-vacuous instance-ID pass, and observed actor transforms within the Bevy parity profile. Recorded substitutions: the cyclist is drawn without its rider through actorModelRefs (riderless catalog GLB; the committed scene state has no wheelSpinRad to pose a rider), and the generic pedestrian.adult actor renders catalog walker walker.pedestrian.0015 (the model catalog/packs/starter-pedestrians maps pedestrian.adult to; pedestrians-carla has no pedestrian.adult entry and the service never substitutes).
